source: Current explicit user request plus bounded independent diagnostics
harness_model_changes: Freeze a new same-model baseline/candidate batch; never switch just one arm or mix historical models as harness gains.

qwen3.8-flash.note: All roles/processes share alias cap; short diagnostic speed is not full-rubric qualification.

hy3.note: Representative input timed out; not a critical dependency until stable on real load.

gemini-3.8-flash.note: No new critical work now. Preserve old evidence; do not wait for recovery.

ramp: Observe real short-workload valid completions, queueing and errors before adding slots. Never use 12 as a target or assume alias capacities are independent.

new_failure_policy.isolated_empty_or_schema_failure: preserve as failed/unassessed, do not kill all independent mainline work
new_failure_policy.two_consecutive_transport_or_empty_on_al: pause that model, continue other assigned work; no automatic retry/refill

enforcement_status: AGENTS instruction and owned diagnostics enforce selected aliases. Existing mainline entrypoints must add pre-dispatch allowlist guard for future batches; no claim that historical runs were retroactively protected.
quality_policy: Rater/profile/epoch explicit. Same paired case both arms graded by same rater. No naive pooling of replacement scores into old Gemini averages.
